name: Cooking Carnage
storyline:
It’s the beginning of a long day of work. You find yourself in a small kitchen, a place that belongs to you only, where you can already hear the humming of your microwave yearning for all the good meals you two will cook and serve together, today. You’re at ease : it’s your own workplace, after all ! And soon enough the counter bell is ringing, as arrives your first customer.

It’s an alien, just like the others, and just like the ones that will come here right after. Oh, you’re used to it now, and you already know what this one will order ! A jelly, made with your signature recipe, cooked with lots of love and… Bits from your last shift ?

Look, your customers approach and quickly fill the seats at your counter. To each their own specific order and… Fresh ingredients to get from these walking meat bags, should you care to grab them.
summary: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !
